vars.label: Daytime population (commuter-adjusted)
vars.ref: US Census Bureau, County-to-County Commuting Flows, American Community Survey 2016-2020 (5-year), Table 1
vars.definition: The people in the municipio on a working day: its residents, plus the workers who come in to work, minus the workers who leave to work elsewhere. Calculated, not surveyed: the Census Bureau's formula for the commuter-adjusted population, with the residents of the 2020 Census and the workers of the 2016-2020 commuting flows. It counts workers only, not students, shoppers or visitors.

vars.label: Daytime change in population from commuting, % of residents
vars.ref: US Census Bureau, County-to-County Commuting Flows, American Community Survey 2016-2020 (5-year), Table 1
vars.definition: Workers who come in to work minus workers who leave to work elsewhere, as a percent of the municipio's residents. Above zero the municipio fills up on a working day; below zero it empties.

vars.label: Resident workers who work in another municipio, % of resident workers
vars.ref: US Census Bureau, County-to-County Commuting Flows, American Community Survey 2016-2020 (5-year), Table 1
vars.definition: Of the workers who live in the municipio and work in Puerto Rico, the share whose workplace is in another municipio.

commuting_flows.name: US Census Bureau, County-to-County Commuting Flows, American Community Survey 2016-2020 (5-year), Table 1
commuting_flows.license: US Government work; cite the Census Bureau as the source
commuting_flows.note: Workers 16 years and over by the municipio where they live and the one where they work, with a 90 percent margin of error for each flow.

census_2020.name: US Census Bureau, 2020 Census: residents by municipio
census_2020.license: US Government work; cite the Census Bureau as the source
census_2020.note: 2020 Census geography and counts (TIGERweb 2020 layers and the 2020 block table). Land area is the Census Bureau's AREALAND. Residents are noise-injected below the island; housing units are exact at block level.

notes.kind: calculated: arithmetic on published figures, nothing assumed (HANDOFF decision 107)
notes.formula: daytime population = residents + workers who come in - workers who leave (US Census Bureau, Calculating Commuter-Adjusted Population Estimates)
notes.period: flows of 2016-2020, labeled 2020; residents of the 2020 Census
notes.outside_puerto_rico: 2,657 workers who live in Puerto Rico work outside it and 1,860 who work in it live outside it; both are counted
notes.work_elsewhere: the workers who work outside Puerto Rico are left out of both sides of the share, as on the Connections between municipios page (transit_links.json)
notes.margins: 90 percent; the root of the sum of the squares of the flows' margins; the census count has none
